title: How HTML, CSS and JavaScript Work Together
learningObjectives: Explain the main ideas in your own words
Apply the workflow to a small project
Identify mistakes and correct them safely

understand.concept: HTML describes the structure and meaning of page content. CSS controls its presentation, such as colour, spacing and layout. JavaScript adds behaviour, such as responding to a click or updating information.
understand.whyItMatters: Together they form a useful mental model: HTML provides meaningful content, CSS presents it clearly, and JavaScript responds to user actions. A browser coordinates all three; none is a complete website by itself.
understand.history: This lesson focuses on current, practical web-development concepts; historical claims are omitted where they are not needed.
understand.analogy: Imagine a theatre: HTML is the script and stage structure, CSS is lighting and costume, and JavaScript is the action triggered during the performance. The analogy is limited because these technologies interact and can each affect more than one aspect.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is only a learning aid, not a complete description of technical behaviour.

explain.narrative:
HTML describes the structure and meaning of page content. CSS controls its presentation, such as colour, spacing and layout. JavaScript adds behaviour, such as responding to a click or updating information.

Together they form a useful mental model: HTML provides meaningful content, CSS presents it clearly, and JavaScript responds to user actions. A browser coordinates all three; none is a complete website by itself.

Imagine a theatre: HTML is the script and stage structure, CSS is lighting and costume, and JavaScript is the action triggered during the performance. The analogy is limited because these technologies interact and can each affect more than one aspect.
